controls.label: Paragraph
controls.default: Umoya Afrika Tours (Pty) Ltd ("Umoya", "we", "us", "our") is a South African private company. We are committed to protecting your privacy and to processing your personal information lawfully, fairly and transparently in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013 ("POPIA").

rows.pv_p: Umoya Afrika Tours (Pty) Ltd ("Umoya", "we", "us", "our") is a South African private company. We are committed to protecting your privacy and to processing your personal information lawfully, fairly and transparently in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013 ("POPIA").

This Privacy Policy explains what personal information we collect when you visit our website, enquire about a journey, make a booking or otherwise interact with us; the purposes for which we use it; the parties with whom we may share it; how long we keep it; and the rights you have in relation to it.
Umoya Afrika Tours (Pty) Ltd is the responsible party in terms of POPIA for the personal information processed through this website.

controls.label: Item
controls.default: Identity and contact details, including your name, email address, telephone number and country of residence.

rows.pv_li: Identity and contact details, including your name, email address, telephone number and country of residence.
Booking and travel details, including passport information, nationality, dietary requirements, mobility considerations, emergency contact details and travel preferences.
Payment information you submit to us or to our payment processors in connection with a deposit or booking.
Any other information you choose to share with us in correspondence, on enquiry forms or during the planning of your journey.

controls.label: Item (HTML)
controls.default: Technical information such as your IP address, device type, browser type and operating system.

rows.pv_li_markup: Technical information such as your IP address, device type, browser type and operating system.
Usage information such as the pages you visit on our website, the time and duration of your visit and the pages you came from.
Information collected through cookies and similar technologies, as described in our Cookie Policy.

controls.label: Item
controls.default: To respond to your enquiry and provide you with information about our journeys.

rows.pv_li: To respond to your enquiry and provide you with information about our journeys.
To prepare quotations, manage bookings and deliver the journey you have selected.
To make travel arrangements with accommodation providers, transport operators, guides and other suppliers necessary for the delivery of your journey.
To communicate with you about your booking, your journey and any related logistics.
To process payments and to manage refunds where applicable.
To comply with our legal, regulatory, accounting and tax obligations.
To improve our website, our journeys and the way we serve our guests.
To send you marketing communications about Umoya, but only where you have given us your consent to do so or where you are an existing client and the law permits.

controls.label: Item
controls.default: Destination management companies, accommodation providers, transport operators, guides, restaurants and experience providers contracted to deliver your journey.

rows.pv_li: Destination management companies, accommodation providers, transport operators, guides, restaurants and experience providers contracted to deliver your journey.
Our holding company, Nyanu Heritage Tours LLC (United States), where it is the entity that has collected your payment or otherwise supports the delivery of your booking.

Service providers that support our business, including our customer-relationship management platform (HubSpot, Inc.), our website, network and security infrastructure (Cloudflare, Inc.), our cookie consent management platform (CookieYes Limited) and our payment processors (Stripe, Inc. and, where offered, PayPal, Inc.).
Banks, payment processors and card networks involved in receiving your payment.
Our professional advisors, including legal, accounting and tax advisors, where the engagement so requires.
Regulators, government authorities or law-enforcement agencies where we are required by law to do so.

controls.label: Paragraph
controls.default: Some of the recipients with whom we share personal information are located outside the Republic of South Africa, or use infrastructure that may store or process information outside the Republic. In particular, HubSpot, Inc., Cloudflare, Inc., Stripe, Inc. and PayPal, Inc. are United States-based service providers; CookieYes Limited is based in the United Kingdom and the European Union; and Nyanu Heritage Tours LLC is located in the United States. Other suppliers and partners may be located in the country where your journey is delivered.

rows.pv_p: Some of the recipients with whom we share personal information are located outside the Republic of South Africa, or use infrastructure that may store or process information outside the Republic. In particular, HubSpot, Inc., Cloudflare, Inc., Stripe, Inc. and PayPal, Inc. are United States-based service providers; CookieYes Limited is based in the United Kingdom and the European Union; and Nyanu Heritage Tours LLC is located in the United States. Other suppliers and partners may be located in the country where your journey is delivered.

Where we transfer personal information outside the Republic, we do so in accordance with section 72 of POPIA, on the basis that the recipient is subject to laws, binding rules or contractual obligations that provide an adequate level of protection, that you have consented to the transfer, or that the transfer is necessary for the performance or conclusion of a contract with you.

controls.label: Paragraph
controls.default: We take reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect personal information against loss, damage, unauthorised access and unlawful processing. These measures include access controls and authentication, encryption of data in transit and (where appropriate) at rest, the use of reputable cloud-based service providers bound by their own data-protection terms, antivirus, anti-malware and regular software updates on devices used to access personal information, and confidentiality obligations imposed on our employees, contractors and service providers.

rows.pv_p: We take reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect personal information against loss, damage, unauthorised access and unlawful processing. These measures include access controls and authentication, encryption of data in transit and (where appropriate) at rest, the use of reputable cloud-based service providers bound by their own data-protection terms, antivirus, anti-malware and regular software updates on devices used to access personal information, and confidentiality obligations imposed on our employees, contractors and service providers.

In the event of a security compromise that affects your personal information, we will notify you and the Information Regulator as soon as reasonably possible, in accordance with section 22 of POPIA. Notification to affected data subjects will be made in a manner that provides sufficient information to allow you to take protective measures against the potential consequences of the compromise.

controls.label: Item
controls.default: Be notified that we are collecting personal information about you, and that your personal information has been accessed or acquired by an unauthorised person.

rows.pv_li: Be notified that we are collecting personal information about you, and that your personal information has been accessed or acquired by an unauthorised person.
Request, free of charge, confirmation of whether we hold personal information about you.
Request access to your personal information.
Request that we correct or delete personal information that is inaccurate, irrelevant, excessive, out of date, incomplete, misleading or unlawfully obtained.
Object, on reasonable grounds, to the processing of your personal information.
Withdraw any consent you have given us at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out before withdrawal.
Object to the processing of your personal information for purposes of direct marketing.
Lodge a complaint with the Information Regulator (South Africa).
